# A Masmorra do Silêncio / The Silent Dungeon — full summary

> A text game where every click cuts like a blade. Play free at https://ftuyama.github.io/silent-dungeon/

## Elevator pitch

Beneath the city, the **green pulse** never stops. The **Silent Dungeon** (*A Masmorra do Silêncio*) opens its mouth: damp stone, rusted iron, and a **silence** that learns your name before you speak it. Whether for honor, greed, or despair, the first step is always the same: **descend**.

This is a browser-based interactive fiction game with turn-based combat, Braille ASCII scene art, inventory, factions, and a chaptered campaign whose ending depends on your choices.

## How to play

- Open https://ftuyama.github.io/silent-dungeon/ in a modern web browser.
- No installation or account required.
- JavaScript must be enabled.
- In-game language can be switched between Brazilian Portuguese and English.

## What players get

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Branching choices | Decisions open paths and close others. |
| Dungeon atmosphere | Catacombs, rituals, stone mouths, things in the corners. |
| Turn-based combat | Initiative, physical attacks, spells, stress, flee vs victory. |
| Chaptered campaign | Story unfolds in acts; multiple endings. |
| ASCII art | Braille-pattern scene illustrations and enemy sprites. |
| Companions & factions | Reputation with Vigília, Círculo, Culto; companion arcs. |

## Content note

Dark fantasy. Sensitive themes include death, cults, and implied violence. Discretion advised.

## Survival tips (from the author)

- Read everything — clues hide in long descriptions.
- Do not rush — the game rewards imagining the space before clicking.
- Death is a consequence, not a bug — try another angle.

## Technical context (for developers and crawlers)

- Engine: You Decide (TypeScript, Vite)
- Campaign id: `calvario`
- Source repository: https://github.com/ftuyama/you-decide
- Published build: GitHub Pages at `/silent-dungeon/`

## Alternate names

- Portuguese: A Masmorra do Silêncio
- English: The Silent Dungeon
- Repository/package: silent-dungeon
